3535 release matrix: has any shipped ID3D12ShaderReflection ever named an input struct's members?
=================================================================================================

`triage.py bisect` cannot answer this: it substitutes each release's
dxc.exe, and dxc.exe never calls a reflection interface. So the
instrument is held fixed (dxa.exe from the ground-truth build, which
statically links D3DReflectionDumper) while the thing under test -- the
reflection implementation, which lives in dxcompiler.dll -- is varied by
copying each release's DLL next to it. Each release also compiles the
repro with its own dxc.exe, so the container is period-correct too.

Columns:
  api-member-names : hits for mPos/mColor anywhere in the reflection walk
  selftest         : the walk reached constant-buffer type reflection,
                     so a zero in the previous column is a finding and
                     not a walk that stopped early
  module-annot     : the release's own disassembly carries a field-name
                     annotation for the input struct (!"mPos")
